llm_response.reason: The site displays several key characteristics of a scam website: (1) Items are marked at unusually low prices with extremely high discounts (up to 80%), (2) It claims free shipping on all orders, (3) Claims a 30-day money-back guarantee to exploit buyer psychological reassurance, (4) The privacy statement is vague, and company information is missing or not verifiable, (5) The WHOIS shows the domain was created extremely recently (Dec 2024) and registrant info is fully redacted, typical for scam sites, (6) No real business contact details (such as phone or non-generic business email), (7) Search and social results show users explicitly warn the site is a scam, (8) The site mimics the branding of legitimate 'A Bathing Ape' products, but is not an authorized distributor. These combined factors definitively match the scam characteristics described above.
